st: (Digital) superintelligence, and are humans already cyborgs?

sec.p: Between DALL-E, algorithmic recommendations, Alexa, Roomba and Neuralink, Artificial Intelligence is ever more advanced and pervasive. And so concern grows about the effects these technologies could have on society, the economy, human psychology and, above all, our futuro…

sec.t: ff.36.2 The super-tome on the singularity
sec.p: A book I'd start from to discuss the topic is Superintelligence by Nick Bostrom.
Lex Fridman always has interesting guests. Keeping up with him is very hard: he does a couple of podcasts a week, 2-3 hours each.

sec.t: ff.36.4 Are we already blended with AI?
sec.p: Next time you're at your desk working, put your phone in the desk drawer. Within 5-15 minutes your hand will instinctively jerk towards it. But it won't be in its usual place. For a moment you'll feel mutilated. At least, that's what happened to me.

rel: ff.121 Does flow give you wings?
ff.35 I'm fine, I'm a Super Sapiens
